name: magdev/php-assimp

name: collectiveaccess/providence

family_note: Providence exposes a PHP parser class in app/lib/Parsers. Its conversion path reads PLY vertex and face rows; the adapter supplies a no-op file for an unused Db.php include. Search hits containing copied PlyToStl.php files are not counted as separate packages without independent release and API verification.

name: zelon88/hrconvert2
input_api: convertModels(local ASCII PLY path, local OBJ output path, "obj"); uses PyMeshLab to load PLY and Assimp to export OBJ
scope: One valid ASCII PLY triangle converted through real PyMeshLab and Assimp stages; OBJ geometry and both stage outputs observed
family: HRConvert2 PHP Model pipeline over PyMeshLab PLY reader and Assimp exporter
family_note: Separate tagged GPL PHP application module; PyMeshLab/MeshLab reads PLY and Assimp exports OBJ. The standalone adapter supplies host-application services and omits the web server sandbox. This is one package path over underlying native readers, not an independent PHP syntax parser.
